title: Expose read-only JSON health endpoint for capture surfaces
description:
The measurement lane needs confidence that email capture and attribution entry points stay wired after deploys. Add a public, read-only route such as `GET /api/health/capture-sources` that returns JSON listing the active capture surfaces (e.g. homepage promo signup, homepage promo jump CTA, editor promo invite) with stable route identifiers—no PII, payments, or secrets.

— proposed by briefing agent on 2026-04-17T23:21:53.430Z
acceptanceCriteria: GET `/api/health/capture-sources` on the deployed site returns HTTP 200, `Content-Type` includes `application/json`, and the parsed JSON includes a non-empty array field (e.g. `sources`) with at least three objects each having a `id` string and `path` string.
testPlan: Use an HTTP GET (curl or the tester runner) against production or preview URL and assert status, content-type, and JSON shape.
